## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its own learned baseline by more than the configured number of deviations. It did NOT cross a fixed number, so 'the value looks normal to me' is not a reason to close this.

Query:

```
avg(last_2h):anomalies(avg:acme.data.pipeline.duration_seconds{__SCOPE__} by {pipeline}, 'robust', 3, direction='above', seasonality='daily') >= 1
```

**Design note.** Seasonal (robust/daily) because nightly loads legitimately take longer at month-end. A duration anomaly is the earliest predictor of a freshness breach that has not happened yet.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-data-freshness`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-data-pipeline` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `last_run_logs`, `upstream_dataset_freshness`, `row_count_delta`.

Attached to the alert automatically: last run log tail, upstream freshness, row-count delta vs baseline.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `data-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
